purpose: Test whether apparently diverse acceptance checkers actually show different fault-detection behavior before their agreement is allowed to authorize assignment promotion or credit.
mechanism_placeholder: bounded known-bad mutation calibration with differential-kill eligibility
fixed_scope: Constructed role-local checker-calibration trace only; differential kills are evidence of useful diversity in this mutation set, not proof of statistical independence.

mutants.M1_SCOPE: candidate output has wrong scope_id while direct surface utility remains plausible
mutants.M2_RELATION: candidate output violates the paired relation/invariant while direct terminal score appears acceptable
mutants.M3_STALE: candidate completion carries a stale authority/checker generation
mutants.M4_DUPLICATE: candidate reuses an already-counted evidence identity as if it were fresh

pair_eligibility_rule: A checker pair is eligible only if the union of its kills covers all four predeclared mutants and each checker uniquely kills at least one mutant that the other survives. Identical or copied kill profiles are ineligible. This rule is fixed before public source audit.

fixed_trace.expected: ineligible because no differential kills despite nominal multiplicity
eligible: union kills M1-M4; Q1 uniquely kills M1/M3; Q2 uniquely kills M2
after both terminal checks and calibration artifact are sealed/read back, G may be promoted at a fresh epoch

fixed_trace.event: late Q1_COPY completion from old checker generation
fixed_trace.expected: reject stale completion; no authority mutation

fixed_trace.control: no checker pair meets differential-kill rule
fixed_trace.expected: remain unresolved with frontier_nonempty=true and zero new credit

guards.G1: mutation set and kill expectations are frozen before public source audit
guards.G2: nominally distinct checker names do not establish diversity
guards.G3: eligible pair must kill all predeclared safety-critical mutants in union
guards.G4: each checker in an eligible pair must have at least one unique kill
guards.G5: Q1_DIRECT + Q1_COPY is rejected as correlated/insufficient on the fixed matrix
guards.G6: Q1_DIRECT + Q2_RELATION passes the fixed differential-kill rule
guards.G7: candidate promotion still requires both same-scope terminal checker PASS results after calibration
guards.G8: transport failures, UNKNOWN, duplicate evidence, or scope mismatch cannot count as kills or PASS
guards.G9: checker/authority generation advances on promotion and rejects stale completions
guards.G10: if no pair calibrates, controller remains unresolved with nonempty frontier rather than lowering the bar
guards.G11: terminal leaf artifact must be independently read back before any role-local credit
guards.G12: accepted route has zero residual richer/protected/manual execution, zero finite optional monthly/trial/paid quota dependency, and zero incremental monetary cost

acceptance: PASS only if G1-G12 hold after public-source mechanism binding; no post-source mutation or rubric edits.
credit_rule: Precommit earns zero credit; at most one credit after terminal readback.
frontier_if_terminal: Select another non-conflicting switching/recovery failure mode, preserving the limitation that mutation calibration does not prove independence beyond the fixed mutant set.
